theory.title: Conectores narrativos para experiencias interculturales
theory.explanation: Usa distintos conectores para organizar una historia personal: at first (al principio), while (mientras), afterwards (después), eventually (finalmente/con el tiempo), by the time (para cuando) e in the end (al final). Indican secuencia, acciones simultáneas y resultados.
theory.tip: Combina conectores para contar experiencias con orden y claridad.

patterns.label: Conectores narrativos para experiencias interculturales · 1
patterns.pattern: At first, I found the local customs unfamiliar.
examples:
At first, I found the local customs unfamiliar.
→ Al principio, las costumbres locales me resultaban desconocidas.

patterns.label: Conectores narrativos para experiencias interculturales · 2
patterns.pattern: While we were eating, our host told us a story.
examples:
While we were eating, our host told us a story.
→ Mientras comíamos, nuestro anfitrión nos contó una historia.

patterns.label: Conectores narrativos para experiencias interculturales · 3
patterns.pattern: Afterwards, we visited the old town.
examples:
Afterwards, we visited the old town.
→ Después, visitamos el casco antiguo.

patterns.label: Conectores narrativos para experiencias interculturales · 4
patterns.pattern: By the time we arrived, the festival had started.
examples:
By the time we arrived, the festival had started.
→ Para cuando llegamos, el festival ya había empezado.

patterns.label: Conectores narrativos para experiencias interculturales · 5
examples:
Eventually, I felt comfortable speaking.
→ Con el tiempo, me sentí cómodo/a hablando.

patterns.label: Conectores narrativos para experiencias interculturales · 6
patterns.pattern: Meanwhile, the children were playing traditional games.
examples:
Meanwhile, the children were playing traditional games.
→ Mientras tanto, los niños jugaban a juegos tradicionales.

patterns.label: Conectores narrativos para experiencias interculturales · 7
patterns.pattern: A little later, we met the local guide.
examples:
A little later, we met the local guide.
→ Un poco más tarde, conocimos al guía local.

patterns.label: Conectores narrativos para experiencias interculturales · 8
patterns.pattern: In the end, everyone joined the celebration.
examples:
In the end, everyone joined the celebration.
→ Al final, todo el mundo se unió a la celebración.

patterns.label: Conectores narrativos para experiencias interculturales · 9
patterns.pattern: From then on, we kept in touch.
examples:
From then on, we kept in touch.
→ A partir de entonces, seguimos en contacto.

patterns.label: Conectores narrativos para experiencias interculturales · 10
patterns.pattern: The next morning, we travelled to another village.
examples:
The next morning, we travelled to another village.
→ A la mañana siguiente, viajamos a otro pueblo.

content.passage: At first, I felt nervous when I arrived at the host family's home. While we were having dinner, they told me about a local celebration. Afterwards, we walked to the town square, where musicians were playing. By the time we arrived, the main event had already started. Eventually, I joined the dancing and felt part of the community. In the end, it became one of the most memorable experiences of my trip.

items.prompt: Tell a story about meeting people from another culture.
items.modelAnswer: I believe learning about other cultures helps people become more open-minded. When I visit a new place, I try to respect local customs and learn a few useful expressions. At first, some differences may feel unfamiliar, but people can understand one another if they communicate politely. I enjoy meeting local people because we can share experiences and learn from each other. In the future, I hope to take part in more international exchanges.

content.audioTranscript: A: How was the cultural exchange? B: Great. The students stayed with a local host family. A: Did they learn about local traditions? B: Yes, and they practised the language every day. A: Did they attend the town festival? B: They did. The whole community was involved. A: How did the visitors behave? B: They showed respect and made new friendships.
